title: Letters to Rain
synopsis: Two strangers keep a shared notebook on a rainy-day bench, never meeting, always replying.

chapters.title: The Bench
chapters.content:
Every Tuesday it rained, and every Tuesday Lan left a page in the blue notebook under the bench.

The first reply came in the third week, in handwriting she did not know: 'I read yours. Please keep writing.'

chapters.title: The Reply
chapters.content:
She wrote about the bakery, the cracked umbrella, the song she could not name.

The next Tuesday the answer named the song, and added one line: 'Bring the umbrella. I would like to know who owns it.'
